instructions: The user is out with only a dumb phone that gets WhatsApp messages as SMS. Should the new messages (marked is_new) be sent to that phone? Older messages are only context. Only send what the user needs to see before they are back at their smartphone. Messages from "me" are the user's own.

rules: Someone wants to meet, or is planning, changing or confirming where or when to meet, eat or go somewhere
It asks the user a question or needs an answer or decision from them soon
Urgent, time-sensitive or important personal news
A shared link, video, meme, photo or sticker without a question or plan for the user
Small talk, reactions, thanks, ok, laughing or emoji
The user wrote in this chat in the last few minutes, so they are following it already
It adds nothing new to messages from the same chat already sent to the dumb phone
